title: Kanau — Light, as you imagined it.
description: Kanau is an app that controls DMX lighting from an iPhone or iPad. It sends Art-Net, sACN and CRMX.
lead:
Your iPhone or iPad becomes a DMX lighting console.
Stand by the light, and set brightness and color while you watch it.
f1_h: Eyes on the light, fingers on the faders.
f1_p: A fader moves by how far your finger travels, not by where it lands. You can work it without looking down.
f2_p: Choose an effect from the list. Or pick two colors, and Kanau blends them across the pixels.
f3_p: Scan a QR code and another iPhone or iPad joins the same lights. The host decides whether it may control them.
ipad_p: An iPad in landscape shows 30 faders on a page. 40 on the 13-inch. It works the same as on iPhone.
price_sub:
Every feature is free up to 64 channels in Universe 1.
For more than that, there is Pro. The first month of Pro Monthly is free.
free_li: Up to 64 DMX channels in Universe 1

lifetime_per: Buy once, keep it for good

feats: During the wait between takes, dims only the lights you choose.
Locks the screen while the iPhone hangs from your neck strap.

Turns the screen of an iPhone or iPad into a light you control by DMX.

A desk for the light you already see.

support_description: Contact Kanau, in any language: info@kanaulabs.app. Requirements and the most common questions.
support_body:
Contact

info@kanaulabs.app

Write in any language.

For a bug report, please include the fixture model and mode, the output route (Art-Net / sACN / CRMX), and the app version, which is shown at the end of Settings → Settings.

Requirements

  • iOS 17 or later. iPhone is portrait; iPad is landscape.
  • Over the network (Art-Net / sACN) — the iPhone and the lighting nodes must be on the same network. The app asks for Local Network permission the first time.
  • Over Bluetooth (CRMX) — the app asks for Bluetooth permission the first time.

If something is not working

The troubleshooting chapter of the manual is arranged by symptom. These are the three we are asked about most.

No light

Kanau starts with output off each time it opens: tap OUTPUT OFF at the top left and slide to send. If Network Output in Settings → Output shows a figure in packets/s, the app is sending, and the problem is further down the line. Nothing means it is not sending.

sACN multicast is refused

iOS can refuse multicast sending. When the screen says so, switch to unicast and enter the node's address.

A fixture is missing from the library

Send us the manufacturer and model name. You can also build the definition yourself in the app, or import a GDTF file.
privacy_description: Kanau collects nothing. What the app connects to, and why.
privacy_body:
What we collect

Nothing. Kanau Labs does not collect, receive, or store any information about you. There are no Kanau accounts, no analytics, and no advertising.

The same goes for our separate app, Kanau Lite: it collects nothing.

Data the app creates

Your patch, scenes, settings, and MIDI assignments stay on your device. Files you export go wherever you choose to put them.

Images and videos you add to Media in LITE MODE, from the Photos app or from files, are copied onto this device and stay there. The same goes for Media in Kanau Lite.

The motion sensor is used only while TILT is on in ZEN, to move a fader with the device's tilt. Nothing is recorded or sent.

What the app connects to

  • Local network — Art-Net and sACN to lighting nodes on the same network, sessions between your own devices, and receiving DMX in LITE MODE
  • Bluetooth — DMX to CRMX transmitters, and Bluetooth MIDI controllers
  • Camera — only to read a session's QR code when you join one. Nothing is recorded or sent
  • The internet — only when you use GDTF Share. You sign in with your own GDTF Share account, and the app connects to gdtf-share.com to list and download fixture definitions. Your sign-in goes to GDTF Share only; if you choose to have it remembered, it is kept in this device's keychain. Kanau Labs runs no server and receives nothing. Your GDTF Share account is covered by GDTF Share's own terms

The local network and Bluetooth go to equipment on your own site.

Third parties

Kanau contains no third-party SDKs, analytics, or ad networks, and shares nothing with anyone. The only outside service it talks to is GDTF Share, and only when you sign in to it.

Children's privacy

Because nothing is collected, nothing is collected from anyone of any age.

Changes

If this policy changes, the date on this page is updated.

Contact

info@kanaulabs.app — write in any language.
